headline: As of 2026-10-13: 3,352,886 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 34 of 50 states, D+24.4 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 3,352,886 early/mail ballots cast so far across 34 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+24.4 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Florida (527,902), Virginia (519,970), Michigan (393,689).
